title: Filo naming: domain registration availability evidence
intendedMarket: Studi e imprese di servizi, PMI italiane
scope: Eight initial candidates across .it and .com; optional .eu for three finalists.
decisionRule: Confirm available only with authoritative registry not-found response containing actual HTTP 404/errorCode404, or an explicit candidate-specific registrar available result. Search absence, DNS absence, generic web errors and no WHOIS data are insufficient.

officialGuidance.finding: Check Whois for registration availability; register through a Registrar. Registry does not directly register for users.

cautions: No domain has been purchased or reserved.
Availability can change before checkout, and premium/reserved status requires registrar confirmation.
Domain status is separate from trademark availability and social handle availability.
checkedAt records observation/report capture, not a guaranteed fresh registry database snapshot.
